craft_notes: Sthāyin: relish — six-grade sonic ladder. Rows: revel then grades. Rejected: translating nāda-grades away — killed: ladder kept sounding. Read aloud: rising scale.

lines: Who would dwell savor-made midst drink and delight, play and laughter —
through unvoiced voice, roar, outburst, hearkening, humming, hum's end.
